tiers.text: Look at the plot, then at the score. Which looks more trustworthy, and why?
Every question the agent did not ask was answered by default. Scan the function for choices: where do points on a bin edge go, what happens to an empty bin, what does the error bar mean?

Read the scorecard for the acceptance count and write it down. For the reflection, pick two choices you can see in the code that nobody discussed, such as the edge convention or what an empty bin returns.
The gate unlock answer is the number of client acceptance tests that passed in your last ./tdd score. Run ./tdd score in the gate terminal to see it.
